mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as markets anticipate accommodative policy.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% for two consecutive months signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC remains negative over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
evidence_refs: doc:Consumer Spending and Equity Market Correlation
failure_condition: Positive returns occur in less than 45% of interaction events, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained industrial production growth (INDPRO > 102.5 for three consecutive months) signals manufacturing expansion that boosts corporate capital expenditure and profit margins, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
evidence_refs: doc:Industrial Production and Corporate Earnings Linkage
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of high INDPRO periods, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly real GDP growth (GDPC1 > 0.5% YoY) indicates expanding economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of positive GDPC1 growth quarters, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% signals persistent price pressures that triggers aggressive Fed tightening, reducing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods, or the Rank IC remains negative over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 150k monthly increase) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) indicates a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
evidence_refs: doc:Labor Market Tightness and Equity Performance
failure_condition: Positive returns occur in less than 45% of interaction events, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%) and rising interest rates (FEDFUNDS increase > 0.25% monthly) signal aggressive monetary tightening that reduces corporate borrowing and consumer spending, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of regime-conditional periods, or the interaction term's Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.
